name: Tai-Anara
source:
Tai-Anara is an almost omnipotent and cunning primordial phantom who skillfully deceives mortals. His favorite “meal” consists of worlds lacking light and the energy of happiness—Taim-Chei.

Tai-Anara was born alongside the Universe itself. His purpose of existence is the destruction of worlds—a process that is nearly inevitable. At the same time, Tai-Anara is not inherently evil; annihilating worlds is simply the essence of his being. He possesses the ability to take control of the minds of other beings, a state from which escape is said to be impossible—or is it?

By the beginning of The Beexen’s Tale, Beexen, under Tai-Anara’s influence, controls most of Dreamsted.
